command.addWorkspace: Add this workspace as a project
description: A task board for AI coding tasks: queue work, approve tool permissions, review changes before accepting them, and track spending per project.
view.home.welcome:
Assign work to Claude Code. Each task runs on its own git branch, and you review the diff before merging.
[Open Task Board](command:agentTaskBoard.open)
[Add this workspace as a project](command:agentTaskBoard.addWorkspace)
Requires Claude Code signed in (Pro/Max plan) or an Anthropic API key.
[Sign in to Claude Code](command:agentTaskBoard.loginClaude)
[Use an API key](command:agentTaskBoard.openSettings)
[Open in browser](command:agentTaskBoard.openInBrowser) · [Show log](command:agentTaskBoard.showLogs)
config.claudePath: Path to the Claude Code CLI executable. Leave empty to detect it automatically (the Claude Code extension, then `claude` on PATH). Run **Restart server** after changing it.
config.idleShutdownMinutes: Stop the background server after this many idle minutes (no window has the Task Board open and no task is running, waiting or scheduled). `0`: never stop.
